_comment: Hearthbound: BWG biomes for Naturalist's has_butterfly. BWG already inherits every tag-based Naturalist entry (#minecraft:is_forest / is_taiga / is_jungle / is_savanna / is_badlands / is_mountain), so only the entries Naturalist gates on the LITERAL vanilla biomes minecraft:swamp, minecraft:plains and minecraft:desert are patched here — no modded biome can ever join those. Mirrors the same gap RU was patched for.
